pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Open, Main Line
pages.notes: Overview was generic; plan 1 routed the b1-knight via f1 with the rook there; plan 3 named control of e5, which White's pawn occupies. Rewrote the overview and plans to the 8...Be6 structure. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Open, Skipworth Gambit
pages.notes: Plans named an open d-file that is not open, treated 7.Nxe5 as winning an extra pawn when it only restores material, and sent the c8-bishop to b7 or c6, both occupied. Rewrote overview and plans around the a4-c6 pin, 7.Bxc6+ and 7.Nxe5.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Open, Zukertort Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an ambiguous Nd2 and a route through the f1-rook; plan 2 put both the knight and bishop on e7; plan 3 called the d-file open. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez:Riga Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 named ...Ng4, which no knight can reach; plan 3 claimed a d-file pin that does not exist; plan 4 said White has a material advantage when Black is a pawn up. Rewrote plans around the real pins and the 9.Nxc6 Bxh2+ main line. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez:Riga Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 named ...Ng4 and ...Nf5, which no knight can reach; rewrote it around the pinned e4-knight and ...Bc5 pinning the d4-knight. British spelling (a spelling-pass typo, centreed, was caught by the reviewer and corrected).

pages.name: Ruy Lopez:Riga Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 suggested Kg1, which the h2-bishop covers; plans 3 and 4 misdescribed the material. Rewrote plans around 10...Qh4 and the 11.Rxe4+ endgame line. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, 7.Bb3 d5
pages.notes: Overview was generic; plan 2 named a white e4-pawn that is gone; plan 3 routed the f3-knight via d2-f1 with the rook on f1. Rewrote overview and plans around 8.dxe5 and 8.Nxe5.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, 8...Be6 9.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight through the f1-rook and lifted a rook from e1 that is not there; plan 2's ...f5 was not a real idea here. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, 8.Nxe5
pages.notes: Plan 3 named an e5-pawn that is a knight; plan 1 had c3 and Nc3 together. Rewrote plans around 8...Nxe5 9.dxe5. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Bernstein, 11.Bxe6
pages.notes: Overview and plans 2-3 credited Black with a bishop pair it does not have and named a c3-knight that is a pawn; overview and plans 1-3 rewritten and accepted. Plan 4 (long-range power of the bishops) is still wrong: two rewrites were rejected (first: White takes on d4 at once so the choice does not arise; second: named knights on d4 and e6 with no sequence), so the old text was restored.
